recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. If the behavior regresses in a current validator release, address it in the external validator/core-library source and release process rather than in this specification checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-15926 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request reporting that ValidationEngine.loadIg assumed IG packages were all R4 and failed for IG packs produced for older implementation guides.
initial_application: No commit mentioning FHIR-15926 was found. Git history shows the matching implementation in c5c6d7cc08dd2e61af72118a2e757c64ccddb16a, 'fix validation engine loading of versioned packages', which changed ValidationEngine and PackageCacheManager to resolve versioned packages and install package cache entries using package metadata.
additional_context: The old org.hl7.fhir.validation Java source is not active in the current FHIR-core checkout. The current build references ca.uhn.hapi.fhir org.hl7.fhir.validation and related core-library artifacts from ivy.xml and build.gradle.kts, while source/validation.html only points readers to the tools registry for validators and contains no obsolete loadIg guidance.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The historical source fix matches the approved request, and there is no current in-build FHIR-core source or narrative surface requiring a correction for this issue.
